2121956885779919262.en_summary: StockSavvyShay: Compute pricing is becoming as much about contract duration as the chips themselves with 5-year deals across $IREN and $CRWV around $20–25 per watt-year versus $40–50 for short-term capacity and new $SPCX contracts above $50. That spread creates an interesting opportunity for $NBIS whose 2026 base sits near $12 while newer short-term deals exceed $40 leaving room for realized pricing to rise as its contract mix shifts toward higher rates. You can see the same dynamic within SpaceX where $ANT initial agreement priced near $30 while $GOOGL is paying $53–79 including H100s at more than 3x the rental index suggesting contract timing and guaranteed access are becoming just as important as the GPU itself.
2121956885779919262.zh_summary: StockSavvyShay：計算定價越來越關乎合約期限而非芯片本身，$IREN 和 $CRWV 的 5 年交易約 20–25 美元每瓦年，對比短期產能 40–50 美元，以及新 $SPCX 合約超過 50 美元。這種差距為 $NBIS 創造了有趣機會，其 2026 年基礎接近 12 美元，而較新短期交易超過 40 美元，隨著合約組合轉向更高費率，實現定價有上升空間。SpaceX 內部也可看到相同動態，$ANT 初始協議定價接近 30 美元，而 $GOOGL 支付 53–79 美元包括 H100，超過租賃指數 3 倍以上，表明合約時機和保證訪問變得與 GPU 本身同樣重要。

ticker_notes.NBIS: 2026 base near $12 vs short-term >$40, room for pricing rise as mix shifts
